highlights: Result Update 09th November, 2026 BUY Target Price 1,060 Hindalco Industries Ltd Metals & Mining 1 Indian Operations Outshine; Structural Growth Remains Intact Est.
Actual for Q2FY27: Revenue - BEAT; EBITDA - BEAT; PAT - BEAT Change in Estimates post Q2FY27Results FY27E/FY28E: Revenue: 7.2%/7.2%; EBITDA: 6.9%/-3.5%; PAT: 2.3%/-5.5%.

Recommendation Rationale • Upstream Aluminium Operating Resilience Buffers Cost Headwinds: Upstream Aluminium EBITDA/ton stood at robust $2,125/t (up 40% YoY), supported by steady third-party upstream dispatches of 233 kt (up 3%/ 6% YoY/QoQ), higher net export premiums, and value-added upstream pricing.

While Q2FY27 CoP rose ~5% QoQ due to heavy northern monsoon disruptions and low coal linkage materialization, management expects an additional ~5% QoQ rise in Q3FY27 before coal costs soften in Q4FY27.
